judgment_text:
PRAYER : This Criminal Original Petition is filed under Section 528 of BNSS to direct the learned Sessions Judge (Special Court for SC/ST cases), Kallkurichi to consider Petitioner's Bail Application on the same day of surrender in connection with a case in Cr. No.65/2026 on the file of the respondent.

ORDER

1. The criminal original petition has been filed to direct the learned Sessions Judge (Special Court for SC/ST cases), Kallkurichi to consider Petitioner's Bail Application on the same day of surrender in connection with a case in Cr. No. 65/2026 on the file of the respondent.

2. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner as well as the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the first and second respondents.

3. Considering the submissions made and upon perusal of the materials available on record, it is seen that, in this case, on 18-2-2016, information was received that one Santhosh, S/o. Balamurugan, was employed as a bonded labourer by the petitioner in the Kattukottai area. Based on the said information, a team headed by the Tahsildar, along with the defacto complainant/Village Administrative Officer, the Revenue Divisional Officer, the Zonal Deputy Tahsildar, the Labour Inspector, members of the Child Welfare Committee, and police officials, visited the field of the petitioner at about 9.30 a.m. During the inspection, they found that the said Santhosh, who belongs to the Scheduled Caste community, was working as a bonded labourer under the petitioner. Consequently, the third respondent, namely, the Village Administrative Officer of Thenchettiyandal Village, Kallakurichi District, lodged a complaint against the petitioner.

4.In view of the above factual position, there shall be a direction to the the learned Sessions Judge (Special Court for SC/ST cases), Kallkurichi to consider the petitioners” bail application, preferably on the same day of his surrender, in connection with Crime No. 65 of 2026 on the file of the second respondent Police and to pass appropriate orders in accordance with law, after affording due opportunity to the victim under Section 15-A of the SC/ST (PoA) Act, 1989. The petitioners shall surrender before the jurisdictional Court concerned within a period of fifteen days from the date of the receipt of a copy of this order.

5. The Criminal Original Petition stands disposed of accordingly.
